0.0: Do you know what May 11th is? That's right, it's MapleStory's Anniversary! Isn't it wonderful? 6 years already! I've prepared a special event to celebrate. What do you say? Want to give my event a try?

yes.0: Please bring me #b66 Diamond 6 Cards that look like #i04032655##k.You should find them pretty easily if you hunt nearby monsters. \nYou can get the cards from monsters at your level.

no.0: Hmph. That's fine. If you change your mind, come see me.

1.0: Great! Full of 6s. I feel so...wonderful just looking at them.

item.0: You haven't collected 66 #b#t04032655#s#k yet? They're easy to find! I could get them, but what fun would that be? Hurry up!
